items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: Yes, George Dano talks about him, says he was wonderful.

ctx.x: Well, as far as I can remember, I just would sit up there and I used to go up there and listen to those bands play. They used to play in what we call the buzzard roof in these dance halls. We had to go upstairs. Oh yeah, the balcony. Upstairs in the balcony. And I used to go up there just a kid and sit down. I'd sit next to Buddy and just listen to him play. As far as I'm concerned, he played everything. Of course, Manuel Perez was at the Roof Garden. And there he had a great banjo player with him. I have never…
Yes, George Dano talks about him, says he was wonderful. And the younger banjo player over there, he started in 1927. He talks about...
Well, the reason why I believe they don't talk too much about Caffrey. Caffrey was a little touchy. He was awful touchy.
